title: The standalone contract window opens a plug-in's settings editor and offers in-app updates

installed_sdk.rationale: StandaloneApp gains set_test_hooks() over a detail test-hooks struct (a settings-editor frame, an update service and an app-menu observer) that defaults to off; the standalone window gains menu items only for a factory that offers EditorRole::settings or an app whose updater offers checks. No sequencer type, transport or timing contract changes.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No timeline CLI command, flag, or output contract changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation, schema, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No runtime operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability or authoring contract changes.
